tagline: Content-aware crop on this device — faces stay in the frame.
description:
The crop runs on this device. Open a picture or take a still — nothing is uploaded. Pick a frame the size of a profile square, a wide banner, a story — the box jumps to the faces and the interesting bits, not the empty sky. Download the JPEG.

This is not a manual crop tool. You do not drag the handles: the picture tells it where to cut, and you can tap a runner-up if you prefer that frame.

The last picture and the last frame come back the next time you open the app, inside this file.

An unofficial port of smartcrop.js by Jonas Wagner.
